description: This file contains the 'UriResolver' class in the 'GuzzleHttp\Psr7' namespace. It provides static methods for resolving and relativizing URI references according to RFC 3986, including removing dot segments from paths and resolving relative URIs against base URIs.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for resolving and relativizing URI references according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments ('..' and '.') from a URI path according to RFC 3986 section 5.2.4, returning the normalized path.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI, returning a new UriInterface instance representing the absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Returns the target URI as a relative reference from the base URI, useful for generating relative links.
